LESSON: VISUAL MEMORY

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.5: Visual memory

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Visual memory. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do you see memory learner should be able to: in visual memory games. around class?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Visual memory
2. Give Kenyan examples for Visual memory
3. Practise Visual memory at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Visual memory using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

2. Answer: Why is Visual memory important for a PP1 learner?
